║                   VENDOR CRUDMODULE - QUICK START                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

🚀 SETUP IN 3 STEPS:

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 1: CREATE DATABASE TABLE                                       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Run the SQL from: Setup/setup.sql

Or copy-paste this:

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vendor_crud_item` (
  `item_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`),
  KEY `VENDOR_CRUD_ITEM_TITLE` (`title`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 2: CLEAR CACHE                                                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

rm -rf var/cache/* var/page_cache/* var/view_preprocessed/*

Or:

php bin/magento cache:flush

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 3: ACCESS THE MODULE                                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

1. Login to Magento Admin
2. Look for menu: CRUD Module → Manage Items
3. Start creating items!

📋 CRUD OPERATIONS:

CREATE:   Admin → CRUD Module → Manage Items → Add New Item
READ:     Admin → CRUD Module → Manage Items (Grid View)
UPDATE:   Click Edit on any item in the grid
DELETE:   Click Delete in Actions OR select multiple & mass delete

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🔐 PERMISSIONS:

Grant access via: System → Permissions → User Roles

Resources:
- Vendor_CrudModule::crud        (Main menu)
- Vendor_CrudModule::item        (View items)
- Vendor_CrudModule::item_save   (Create/Edit)
- Vendor_CrudModule::item_delete (Delete)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚠️  TROUBLESHOOTING:

Issue: Module not in admin menu
Fix:   Clear cache, check ACL permissions

Issue: Table doesn't exist
Fix:   Run the SQL script

Issue: Permission denied
Fix:   Grant ACL resources to your admin role
